name: Indian Independence Day Flag Raising
description: Join HCCD and the community at Pat Bayly Square to celebrate Indian Independence Day with a flag raising ceremony.
detailedDescription:
HCCD proudly celebrated Indian Independence Day with a flag raising ceremony at Pat Bayly Square in Ajax.

The event was joined by local and provincial government officials, including Marilyn Crawford, Nancy Henry, Chirag Bhatt, Juanita Nathan, Rob Cerjanec, Sterling Lee, and Rob Taylor, along with members of the community who came together to honour the occasion.

This event was free and open to the public.

name: Ganesh Visarjan
description: Join HCCD at Alex Robertson Park for Ganesh Visarjan, a community celebration marking the culmination of Ganesh Chaturthi.
detailedDescription:
HCCD invites the community to Alex Robertson Park in Pickering for Ganesh Visarjan, marking the conclusion of the Ganesh Chaturthi festivities.

This event is free and open to the public.

name: HCCD Mega Diwali Light Show
location: J. Clarke Richardson Collegiate, 1355 Harwood Ave N, Ajax, ON
description: Durham Region's first-ever Diwali light show, featuring a 300-drone show and a fireworks display.
detailedDescription:
HCCD presents the Mega Diwali Light Show at J. Clarke Richardson Collegiate — the first ever light show in Durham Region celebrating Diwali.

The evening features a spectacular 300-drone show lighting up the night sky for 16 minutes, followed by a 12-minute fireworks display.

This event is free and open to the public.

name: Navratri Garba Night
location: Pickering High School, 180 Church St N, Ajax, ON, L1T 2W7
description: Celebrate Navratri with HCCD for a night of Garba & Dandiya, live music from Jitendra Joshi and his team, and food stalls for the whole family.
detailedDescription:
Join the Hindu Community Centre of Durham for our Navratri Garba Night — an evening of dance, music, and community celebration!

Dance the night away to live Garba and Dandiya performed by singer Jitendra Joshi and his team from Malhaar Entertainment, with food stalls on-site for the whole family to enjoy.

Early bird tickets are $10 each, or $12 each on the day of the event.

Interested in sponsorship or vendor opportunities? Reach out to us through our Contact page.

name: International Yoga Day Celebration
description: Join us for a morning of yoga, breathwork, and community wellness to celebrate International Yoga Day in the heart of Ajax.
detailedDescription:
Join us for a vibrant morning of yoga, breathwork, and community wellness as we celebrate International Yoga Day in the heart of Ajax.

This free outdoor event welcomes participants of all ages and experience levels — whether you are a seasoned practitioner or stepping onto the mat for the very first time. Certified instructors will guide attendees through a gentle flow, pranayama breathing exercises, and a closing meditation.

Come connect with neighbours, breathe in the open air, and embrace the spirit of unity and wellbeing that International Yoga Day represents. Bring your own mat if you have one; extras will be available on-site.

Light refreshments will be provided. Free entry — all are welcome!

name: Trip to Niagara Falls for Seniors
description: A beautiful day trip to Niagara Falls with our senior community members, full of scenic views, good food, and lasting memories.
detailedDescription:
HCCD organized a wonderful day trip to Niagara Falls for our senior community members, providing a safe, comfortable, and joyful outing for all participants.

The group departed early in the morning by chartered bus and arrived at one of Canada's most iconic landmarks in time for a scenic walk along the Niagara Parkway. Highlights included breathtaking views of the Horseshoe Falls, and several stops to temples in the GTA who were kind enough to provide food!.

The event was organized with accessibility in mind, with volunteers on hand throughout the day to assist seniors as needed. Laughter, stories, and new friendships made this trip truly memorable.

We thank all volunteers, sponsors, and participants who made this special outing possible.

name: Summer Outdoor Community Event
description: A lively outdoor gathering for the whole family with cultural performances, games, and traditional food at Greenwood Community Centre.
detailedDescription:
Our Summer Outdoor Community Event brought together families and friends from across the Durham Region for an afternoon of cultural celebration, fun, and togetherness.

The event featured live classical Indian music and dance performances, traditional folk games for children and adults alike, and a vibrant marketplace of homemade food, sweets, and crafts. Community members showcased their talents on stage while families relaxed on the lawn and connected with one another.

Highlights included a mehndi (henna) corner, a children's activity zone, and a communal dinner featuring dishes from across the Indian subcontinent.

Over 300 attendees joined us on a beautiful summer afternoon. It was a true celebration of community!
